title: Special Chow Mein
ingredients: 3 spring onions, cut into matchsticks, plus extra sliced to serve
1 birds' eye chilli, deseeded and finely chopped
1 large carrot, peeled and cut into thin matchsticks
2 chicken thigh fillets, excess fat removed, finely sliced
CHOW MEIN SAUCE: 2 tbsp light soy sauce, 3 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp Shaoxing rice wine
method: Prepare the sauce in a small bowl by mixing together the soy sauce, oyster sauce and rice wine.
Prepare the garlic, spring onions, chilli, cabbage and carrot, and put them all into one bowl, ready to tip into the pan.

In a sauté pan or wok, heat the sesame oil and stir-fry the chicken for 2 minutes over a high heat. Add the prepared vegetable mix and stir-fry for 4 minutes, keeping the heat high. Tip in the prawns and stir-fry for 2 more minutes.
Next, add the noodles, loosen them up so that you can stir-fry them, add the beansprouts and stir-fry everything for 2 minutes.
Finally, pour in the sauce, spend 30 seconds stirring it in to coat all the ingredients, then serve straightaway, scattered with sliced spring onions.
notes: Great dish for using up leftover roast meat such as pork, chicken or beef. Cut it into fine slices and add it with the vegetables in step 3 so it has a chance to heat through properly.
